title: Lovely Uruguayan Almond Crusted Bake
description: A sweet and crunchy dessert inspired by Uruguayan cuisine, featuring a lovely almond crusted bake.

ingredients.name: Lovely Uruguayan Almond Flour
ingredients.notes: Make sure to use a high-quality almond flour.

ingredients.name: Bake
ingredients.notes: Choose a sweet and moist bake

ingredients.name: Granulated Sugar
ingredients.notes: Adjust the amount to your taste

ingredients.name: Almond Extract
ingredients.notes: Add a hint of almond flavor

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: Use a flaky sea salt for best results

instructions: Prepare the almond flour by sifting it through a fine-mesh sieve.
Cut the bake into 1-inch (2.5 cm) cubes.
In a shallow dish, mix together the almond flour, granulated sugar, and a pinch of salt.
In a separate dish, whisk together the eggs and almond extract.
Dip each cube of bake into the egg mixture, coating it completely, then roll it in the almond flour mixture to coat.
Place the coated bake cubes on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle the melted butter over the top of the bake cubes.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the bake is crispy.
Remove from the oven and let cool on a wire rack for 5 minutes.
Serve warm, dust with powdered sugar if desired.
